summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that defines an nginx web server service. It builds the nginx image from the current directory, exposes HTTP and HTTPS ports to the host machine, and mounts a local source directory into the container so nginx serves files from your project.

explanations.3: The 'build' section tells Docker Compose to build a custom image for this service instead of pulling a pre-made one from Docker Hub.
explanations.4: The 'context: .' means Docker will look for a Dockerfile in the current directory to build the image.
explanations.5: The 'ports' section maps ports from the container to your host machine — the number before the colon is on your computer, the number after is inside the container.
explanations.8: The 'volumes' section creates a live link between a folder on your computer and a folder inside the container, so changes to your local files are immediately visible to nginx.
